publication.technical: Compute single-species Langmuir equilibrium coverage, occupied and vacant site densities and the common adsorption/desorption event rate from kinetic coefficients, partial pressure and total site density. Fixed-temperature identical independent monolayer sites are required. Correct the source divisor and solve the zero-pressure boundary independently; evaluate vacancy directly with independently rounded exact rational outputs.
publication.plain: Supply positive adsorption and desorption coefficients, nonnegative partial pressure and positive total site density in matching arrays. Receive coverage, occupied sites, vacant sites and equilibrium event rate. Vacancies remain independently evaluated near saturation; the rate is not net accumulation. This model excludes competing species, dissociation, multilayers and transient dynamics.
